- As a **Merchant**, I want to see the settlement status of a payment so that I know when funds arrive.

<details>

```gherkin
  Then the payment shows status 'failed' with a reason code
```

</details>

## Spine Position

- Position: Deepening
- Builds on: Trace #11

## Impacted Areas

- Backend: src/settlements/status/StatusService.ts
- Frontend: src/ui/SettlementList.tsx
- Database: —
- APIs: GET /settlements

- Architecture decisions: reuse the status projection the Skeleton added; map failure reason codes in StatusService

feature.title: 🚀 Feature: Payment settlement
feature.body:
## Bounded Context
Payments

## User Stories

### Story 1: Merchant sees settlement status
- As a **Merchant**, I want to see the settlement status of a payment so that I know when funds arrive.

#### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Merchants can see the status of a settled payment
- [ ] Merchants can see why a settlement failed

```gherkin
Scenario: Status shown for a settled payment
  Given a Merchant has a settled payment
  When the Merchant opens the settlement list
  Then the payment shows status 'settled'

Scenario: Status for a failed settlement
  Given a Merchant has a failed settlement
  When the Merchant opens the settlement list
  Then the payment shows status 'failed' with a reason code
```

### Story 2: Merchant exports settlements
- As a **Merchant**, I want to export my settlements so that I can reconcile them in my accounting tool.

```gherkin
Scenario: Export settled payments as CSV
  Given a Merchant has settled payments
  When the Merchant exports the settlement list
  Then a CSV file with one row per settlement downloads
```

## Trace Plan
1. [x] ☄️ Skeleton — Merchant sees settlement status: status for one settled payment (claims: "Status shown for a settled payment") #10
2. [ ] ☄️ Extension — Merchant exports settlements: CSV export on the Spine (claims: "Export settled payments as CSV") #11
3. [ ] ☄️ Deepening — Merchant sees settlement status: failure modes (claims: "Status for a failed settlement") #12

## Delivery Override

- Reason:
